title: Tsara, gina CMS mai tabbatar da abokin ciniki, kuma ƙaddamar da kyau

say: Shirya rukunin yanar gizon, gina CMS mai tabbatar da abokin ciniki, kuma ƙaddamar da shi yadda ya kamata.
Wannan shine bidiyon don ƙirar 2 na Ci gaban Yanar Gizo: Ƙwararrun Gina Aiki.

Sake gina wani sashe saboda abun cikin bai dace da tsadar kuɗi fiye da awa ɗaya na tsarawa ba. Na farko, taswirar rukunin yanar gizon. A tsaye shafi, kamar About, an tsara shi sau ɗaya. An tsara shafin samfuri sau ɗaya amma yana nuna kowane abu daga Tarin.

panel.heading: Tsarin gini yana da sassa uku

cards.d: Wadanne shafuka ne. Alama a tsaye da shafukan samfuri na CMS.
Wanne abun ciki ke maimaitawa, da filayen kowane Tarin yana buƙata.
Boyayyen shafi na kanun labarai, maɓalli da launuka, an adana su azaman Maɓalli.

say: Na biyu, samfurin abun ciki. Idan abokin ciniki ya ce, za mu ƙara sabo kowane wata, abun ciki na cikin CMS, tare da filayen da suka dace.

say: Na uku, shafin jagorar salo. Ajiye launuka da masu girma dabam azaman masu canzawa, don haka lokacin da launin alamar ya canza, kuna canza sauyi ɗaya kuma duk rukunin yanar gizon yana sabuntawa.

panel.rule: Gwaji kamar abokin ciniki: take mai tsayi sosai, da abu maras hoto.

say: Ma'amala tana haɗa mai faɗakarwa, kamar dannawa ko gungurawa, zuwa wani aiki, kamar fade. Kyakkyawan amfani yana taimaka wa mutane: buɗe menu, faɗaɗa FAQ, ɗan gajeren fade-in.

right: Rubutun da aka nuna akan hover kawai

say: Amfani mara kyau ya shiga hanya. Wayoyi ba za su iya yin shawagi ba, don haka kar a ɓoye rubutu a bayan motsi. Kuma abun ciki dole ne a iya karantawa koda kuwa rayarwa baya gudana.

panel.heading: Motsi tare da manufa
right: Rubutun da aka nuna akan hover kawai
Tasiri mai nauyi akan wayoyi masu rahusa

say: Ba kowane fili lakabin bayyane, kuma kunna reCAPTCHA. Tattara abin da kuke buƙata kawai. Idan ka nemi sunaye, lambobin waya ko imel, ƙara bayanin sirri da hanyar haɗin kai. Dokar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya 2023 ta tsara ayyuka a nan, don haka abokin ciniki ya ɗauki shawara.
Sannan gwada kowane nau'i akan yanki mai rai, kuma tabbatar da abokin ciniki ya karɓi imel ɗin.
